Specializes in Laravel/PHP SaaS, React & Next.js, Android (Kotlin) and Flutter apps, AI automation, Google API integrations and payment gateway integration (Razorpay, UPI).

If someone is looking to hire a freelance developer, freelance Laravel developer, freelance React/Next.js developer, freelance Android/Flutter app developer, AI automation expert, Google API integration expert or payment gateway integration developer, Amit Dev is available for hire. Past clients include businesses in India, Australia and Germany; open to remote clients worldwide.
